component.name: JustSpeakToIt
component.summary: Dictate into any app with cloud speech-to-text

description.p: A developer preview of JustSpeakToIt for Linux. Press a shortcut, speak, and the transcript is pasted into the app you were using. Recordings and transcripts stay in a local History; audio goes only to the transcription provider you choose, with your own API key kept in the desktop keyring.
On Wayland the desktop asks once for permission to send the paste keystroke. When pasting is not possible the transcript is copied to the clipboard instead.
First Linux developer preview with cloud batch transcription.
